limitations: Restricted to identical one-symbol base-field-linear leakage on linear computations. Intermediate subfield rank quantifies local leakage dimension but does not decide global LERS existence. Nonlinear leakage, refreshed shares, independently chosen leakage maps, and multiplicative computations are outside scope. The motivating preprint is very recent, so folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk remain material.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: Subfield-rank law for identical leakage under linear computations
